I plan to make a website that gathers data from the NCAA website to help people find out more about the statistics of a team winning and takedown chances. 

## Top 10 teams by year

Each point shows a team's championship points for that year, with the school logo and team name. Hover over a point for the coach and exact values. Rankings and points are from the [NCAA Division I wrestling records](https://s3.amazonaws.com/fs.ncaa.org/Docs/stats/wrestling_champs_records/D1.pdf); logos are loaded from official athletics sites and their image CDNs.

```{r}
logo_images <- team_results |>
  mutate(logo = unname(logo_lookup[team])) |>
  group_by(year, points) |>
  mutate(logo_x = year + (row_number() - (n() + 1) / 2) * 0.24) |>
  ungroup() |>
  pmap(\(year, rank, team, points, coach, logo, logo_x) {
    list(
      source = logo,
      x = logo_x,
      y = points,
      xref = "x",
      yref = "y",
      sizex = 0.2,
      sizey = 4,
      xanchor = "center",
      yanchor = "middle",
      sizing = "contain",
      layer = "above"
    )
  })

team_results |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~year,
    y = ~points,
    color = ~team,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers+text",
    marker = list(size = 17, opacity = 0.8),
    text = ~team,
    textposition = "top right",
    customdata = ~coach,
    hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Coach: %{customdata}<br>Year: %{x}<br>Points: %{y}<extra></extra>",
    showlegend = TRUE
  ) |>
  layout(
    title = "Top 10 NCAA Division I team points by year (2015–2025)",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Year",
      tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = 2015:2025,
      range = c(2014.5, 2025.5)
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Championship points"),
    legend = list(title = list(text = "Team")),
    height = 950,
    images = logo_images
  )
```

## Division II and III championship points

```{r}
#| echo: false

d2_d3_results <- tribble(
  ~division, ~year, ~rank, ~team, ~points, ~coach,
  "Division II", 2025, 1, "Nebraska-Kearney", 115, "Dalton Jensen",
  "Division II", 2025, 2, "Augustana (SD)", 63, "Jason Reitmeier",
  "Division II", 2025, 3, "St. Cloud State", 57.5, "Steve Costanzo",
  "Division II", 2025, 4, "Lander", 56, "R.C. LaHaye",
  "Division II", 2025, 5, "Central Oklahoma", 55.5, "Todd Steidley",
  "Division II", 2025, 6, "University of Mary", 51, "Adam Aho",
  "Division II", 2025, 7, "Central Missouri", 43, "Cody Garcia",
  "Division II", 2025, 8, "Kutztown", 42.5, "Not verified",
  "Division II", 2025, 9, "Maryville (MO)", 39, "Not verified",
  "Division II", 2025, 10, "West Liberty", 38.5, "Danny Irwin",
  "Division III", 2025, 1, "JWU (Providence)", 83.5, "Lonnie Morris",
  "Division III", 2025, 2, "Wartburg", 83.5, "Eric Keller",
  "Division III", 2025, 3, "Augsburg", 74, "Tony Valek",
  "Division III", 2025, 4, "Baldwin Wallace", 69, "Not verified",
  "Division III", 2025, 5, "Wisconsin-La Crosse", 65, "Dave Malecek",
  "Division III", 2025, 6, "Coe", 60, "Not verified",
  "Division III", 2025, 6, "North Central (IL)", 60, "Not verified",
  "Division III", 2025, 8, "Alvernia", 58, "Kriss Bellanca",
  "Division III", 2025, 9, "Coast Guard", 40.5, "Kevin A. Bratland",
  "Division III", 2025, 9, "Wisconsin-Eau Claire", 40.5, "Not verified"
)

d2_results <- d2_d3_results |>
  filter(division == "Division II")

d3_results <- d2_d3_results |>
  filter(division == "Division III")

d2_chart <- d2_results |>
  mutate(team_label = paste(rank, team)) |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~points,
    y = ~team_label,
    type = "bar",
    orientation = "h",
    marker = list(color = "#1f77b4"),
    text = ~points,
    textposition = "outside",
    customdata = ~coach,
    hovertemplate = paste(
      "<b>%{y}</b><br>",
      "Championship points: %{x}<br>",
      "Head coach: %{customdata}",
      "<extra></extra>"
    ),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

d3_chart <- d3_results |>
  plot_ly(
    x = ~year,
    y = ~points,
    color = ~team,
    type = "scatter",
    mode = "markers",
    marker = list(size = 11, opacity = 0.8),
    text = ~paste(team, "<br>Coach: ", coach),
    hovertemplate = "%{text}<br>Year: %{x}<br>Points: %{y}<extra></extra>",
    showlegend = FALSE
  )

d2_chart |>
  layout(
    title = "2025 NCAA Division II national team points",
    xaxis = list(title = "Championship points", rangemode = "tozero"),
    yaxis = list(title = "", autorange = "reversed"),
    margin = list(l = 180, r = 50),
    showlegend = FALSE,
    height = 550
  )

```

```{r}
#| echo: false

d3_chart |>
  layout(
    title = "2025 NCAA Division III team points",
    xaxis = list(
      title = "Year",
      tickmode = "array",
      tickvals = 2025,
      range = c(2024.5, 2027)
    ),
    yaxis = list(title = "Championship points"),
    showlegend = FALSE
  )
```
